'''Baobab Publishing''' was a publishing house the headquarters of which were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manda/Legends|Manda]]. That company had ties with the [[Baobab family]] and notably published the first edition of [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab's]] seminal [[Book/Legends|book]], the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
